utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I've had this heavy pressure in my chest since about seven this morning. It started while I was carrying groceries up the stairs.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: The pressure goes into my left arm and up to my jaw. I've been sweating a lot and I feel a bit sick to my stomach.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I take pills for blood pressure and my cholesterol is high. I smoked for twenty years but quit a while ago. My father had a heart attack at fifty.
